settings.heading: Will it help with my neck pain?
settings.content: Pilo is designed to keep your neck in neutral alignment while you sleep, which many people find reduces morning stiffness. Expect 3–7 nights to adjust. It's a sleep-support product, not a medical treatment; for persistent or severe pain, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

settings.heading: Is there a smell when it arrives?
settings.content: New memory foam can have a light “new” scent for 24–48 hours. Unpack it and let it air in a ventilated room. It's harmless and fades quickly.

settings.heading: Delivery & payment
settings.content: Free delivery to all of Lebanon. Beirut & Mount Lebanon usually 1–2 business days, other regions 2–4. Pay cash or Whish Money when it arrives. We confirm every order on WhatsApp first.

settings.heading: Your neck's working day.
settings.text: Your neck holds up your head for about 16 hours a day, mostly bent toward a screen. Then it gets 8 hours on a pillow that can't hold it up either.

settings.title: Laptop on the desk
settings.text: Screen too low, chin creeping forward. Coffee number one.
settings.label: Neck: bent forward

settings.title: Lunch + scroll
settings.text: Head down over your phone between bites. “Just checking something.”
settings.label: Neck: bent further

settings.title: Traffic on the highway
settings.text: An hour of tense shoulders in the car. Maybe two.
settings.label: Neck: braced

settings.title: Pilo clocks in
settings.text: The contour holds your neck in line, so it finally gets to rest.
settings.label: Neck: off duty

settings.heading: What your neck carries when you look down at your phone.
settings.text: Your head weighs about 5 kg upright. Tilt it forward 60° to read a screen and the estimated load on your neck rises to roughly 27 kg, about the weight of a 7-year-old. Do that for hours a day and it adds up.
settings.source: Estimate from a 2014 biomechanical model: K. Hansraj, “Assessment of stresses in the cervical spine caused by posture and position of the head”, Surgical Technology International.

settings.heading: Bent forward all day. Aligned all night.
settings.text: Your cervical spine has a natural inward curve called lordosis. Hours of looking down at screens push it forward. At night it needs the opposite: Pilo's raised neck roll supports the curve, while the lower central zone lets your head rest at a neutral angle.
settings.bad_text: Collapses under the weight of your head. The neck stays bent and the muscles brace all night.
settings.good_text: Fills the gap between shoulder and head. Neck and spine rest in one straight line.

settings.heading: Press it. Watch it come back.
settings.text: High-density memory foam recovers slowly and evenly. That's why it holds your neck all night instead of flattening under it.

settings.question: Is it normal for Pilo to feel firm or strange at first?
settings.answer: Yes. Your neck has adapted to years of unsupported sleep. Most people need 3–7 nights to adjust to an ergonomic pillow, and you may notice your neck muscles as they adapt to a neutral position. Give it at least a week.

settings.question: Which side of the pillow should I use?
settings.answer:
Side sleepers: use the higher side. It fills the gap between your shoulder and ear.
Back sleepers: use the lower side. Your chin shouldn't tilt toward your chest, and your head shouldn't tip back.

settings.question: Will Pilo fix my neck pain?
settings.answer: Pilo is designed to support healthy cervical alignment while you sleep, which many people find reduces morning stiffness. It is not a medical device or treatment. If you have persistent or severe pain, please consult a doctor or physiotherapist.

settings.question: Is there a smell when I open it?
settings.answer: New memory foam can have a light, harmless “new” scent for 24–48 hours. Remove the packaging and let it air in a ventilated room.

settings.question: Will it make me hot?
settings.answer: The cover uses a breathable cooling fabric, made with Lebanon's humid summers in mind.

settings.question: How do I wash it?
settings.answer: Unzip and machine-wash the cover only on a cold (30°C max), gentle cycle, then air dry. Do not wash or soak the foam. Spot-clean it with a damp cloth and keep it away from direct sun and heaters.

settings.question: Do you deliver everywhere in Lebanon?

settings.question: How does Cash on Delivery work?

settings.question: What is your return policy?
